LESSON: WRITING 5.5.1 SPELLING

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.5: Writing 5.5.1 Spelling
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 5.5.1 Spelling, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why should we spell words correctly? 2. How can we write words with correct spellings?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read samples of print text with appropriate font size and colour contrast with good handwriting. While learners with blindness are read samples of braille texts with good braille writing.

2. discuss aspects of good handwriting such as letter formation, spacing, alignment, and capitalization. While learners with blindness discuss aspects of good braille writing such as letter formation, spacing, alignment, capitalisation and clear dot embossing for braille writing with peers.

3. copy letter patterns of the target letter- sound combinations (sl, ar), from a 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read samples of print text with appropriate font size and colour contrast with good handwriting. While learners with blindness are read samples of braille texts with good braille writing.
2. discuss aspects of good handwriting such as letter formation, spacing, alignment, and capitalization. While learners with blindness discuss aspects of good braille writing such as letter formation, spacing, alignment, capitalisation and clear dot embossing for braille writing with peers.
3. copy letter patterns of the target letter- sound combinations (sl, ar), from a 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 5.5.1 Spelling together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy; the learner’s interaction with digital devices with assistive technology is enhanced as they type words and phrases on digital

devices with assistive technology.

• Communication and collaboration; the learner’s writing skills are improved as they write clearly and spell words correctly.

Values:
Respect; respect is enhanced as the learner appreciates the opinions of peers during group discussions.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self-esteem); the learner’s self-esteem is nurtured as they spell words correctly for effective communication.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Good handwriting/braille writing is emphasized in Kiswahili and Indigenous Language Activities.
